title_original: 미래국방전략위원회의 설치 및 운영에 관한 규정
full_text:
ADDENDA <No. 35894, December 9, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations) The Organization of the Ministry of National Defense and Its Affiliated Agencies is partially amended as follows:

In subparagraph 7 of Article 9-2 (2), "Defense Innovation Committee" shall be replaced with "Future National Defense Strategy Committee".
